name: FERN Foot Gesture Recognition
description: Runs FERN v2 ONNX inference on live camera streams via MediaPipe skeleton extraction. Detects 7 foot gestures in real-time: heel_tap, foot_lift, sideway_kick, forward_step, forward_kick, cross_front, flamingo_bend.
author: Vision-Orchestration

model_path.description: Path to FERN v2 ONNX model

mediapipe_task.description: Path to MediaPipe pose landmarker task file

target_camera.description: Camera name to run inference on

n_cameras.description: Number of cameras in the training config

camera_id.description: Camera ID flag appended to features

window_size.description: Sliding window of frames for inference

confidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold to emit gesture event

smoothing_n.description: Number of predictions to smooth via majority vote
